t1.name: Al Tayer Motors
t1.m1: Hi, is this Land Cruiser still available? I'm interested in booking a viewing.
t1.m2: Hi Faisal, yes it's still available! 👋 We're open until 9 PM today. Would you like to come by?
t1.m3: Could I come around 6 PM tomorrow? Bringing my brother along.
t1.m4: Perfect! I'll be at the Mussafah showroom. Should I prep the car for a test drive too? It's a 20-min loop on Sheikh Zayed Bin Sultan.
t1.m5: Yes please, a test drive would be great. Also do you have the inspection report? Want to review it tonight.
t1.m8: Also brought the service records — single-owner, all stamps from Al Tayer Toyota. Looks like you'll be happy with what you see.

qr.2: Can you hold it for me?

t2.name: Star Motors
t2.m1: Hi, is this Mustang still available? What's the best price you can do?
t2.m2: Hi! Yes, still here. Asking is AED 162,500 — we've already discounted it from 168K. I could go to 158K if you're ready this week.
t2.m3: Let me think about it — 152K cash today?
t2.m4: 155K cash is my floor — that's already below any other dealer in UAE for this exact spec/mileage.
t2.m5: Good news — we've reduced the asking price to AED 154,500. If you're still interested, this is the best I can do.

t3.name: Nasser Motors
t3.m1: Hello, can I book a test drive this Saturday?
t3.m2: Hi Faisal — yes, Saturday is open. What time works for you?
t3.m4: Perfect — 4 PM is yours. We're at Industrial Area 13, Sharjah. Please bring your driving licence. I'll have keys and a chilled water 😉
t3.m6: Confirmed for Saturday at 4 PM. See you then! 🚗

t4.name: Emirates Auto
t4.m1: Hi, is the G63 still available?
t4.m2: Apologies, this vehicle has been sold yesterday. Would you like us to notify you when similar G-Class models become available?
t4.m3: Yes please — notify me on any 2023-2024 G63 under AED 1M.
t4.m4: Done — alert is active. We typically get 1-2 G63 listings a month. I'll personally message you when something fits.

t5.name: Premier Auto
t5.m1: Visited today. Beautiful car. Let me discuss with my wife and come back to you this week.
t5.m2: Of course Faisal — take your time. Thanks for stopping by today. Let us know if you have any questions, and we can also arrange a longer test drive over the weekend if helpful.
